readout.summary: Maui Invitational opener at Lahaina Civic Center (neutral site). Unbeaten No. 21 BYU (5-0, all wins by double digits) is favored over 4-0 Washington, picked 15th in the Big Ten. ESPN BPI gives BYU about 84%; KenPom projects a 9-point BYU win. Both teams shoot heavy volumes of threes.
readout.pick: BYU to win (ESPN BPI 83.8-84%, KenPom); no published spread pick found
readout.injuries: BYU: Robert Wright III (team-high ~24 ppg point guard) day-to-day with a lower-body issue, missed the Nov 19 game, game-time decision per coach Kevin Young (Nov 22); Dawson Baker will play Monday. Washington: none reported (Mady Traore available after knee issue, Ryan Beasley active, per RotoWire Nov 19-20)

games.venue: Zidian Family Arena at Beeghly Center
